description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the acquisition of the land in Karambaketiya, Ududumbara D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette notice is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically deals with the deposit of compensation funds for acquired land, provides detailed descriptions of the land (name, plan number, lot numbers, extent, and location), and falls under "PART III – LANDS" of the gazette. This content is primarily concerned with land and property matters, fitting the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
